title: Night-folk of the Renaissance
summary: How magi of the Crusade see the other beings of the night.

claims.text: Magi may meet vampyrs, werecreatures, ghosts and fae; vampyrs hold old lore but always want a price, and werewolves tend to see magi, like most humans, as little better than cattle.
Wraiths are history without form and know many secrets of the past.

title: Blood Oaths and the magi
summary: How vampyr bonds have snared whole Covenants.

claims.text: A vampyr's blood can bind a mortal like a strong love spell, leaving a thrall who must obey even while hating the master.
Such Blood Oaths have tied magi, sometimes whole Covenants, into alliances with the undead and have eaten away at the courts of Europe.
